# FIT-08 source preparation profiles

[Nightshade pants](nightshade-pants-profile.json) is explicit fixture data for
the original `pants` shape in Apachii Divine Elegance's
`meshes/divineelegance/female/robes/nightshade/robef_1.nif`.
Source SHA-256: `b7dee8dda3a9c5642e262569f0eae398f1082d193a3de6351b49db8c1f2e7bc9`.
The private NIF is supplied through `SCULPTO_MOD_FIXTURE`; it is not included.

The source has392 render vertices/632 faces. The guide follows its authored
pelvis, thighs, calves, feet and toes; aperture anchors identify the waist and
two natural cuffs. Values use the declared source Z-up frame and source units.
This fixture's imported source placement is retained by the acceptance adapter.

`source_selection` keeps the outward surface and its declared incidental-disk
recovery restores an eligible original crotch face. The resulting render
surface has370 vertices/612 original faces; exact-position physical topology
has324 vertices. The20 inward cuff-cap faces are omitted during preparation.
No source vertex moves, no fitted contact chooses a removed face, and no new
triangle is generated. Source UV seams and complete corner lineage survive.

The acceptance checks three intended openings, genus0, source/prepared IoU1.0,
original area accounting, exact NIF handoff, and the fitted result against the
complete original silhouette. The profile does not authorize native cuts,
reduction or parameter retries. It does not establish a universal preparation
recipe for other garments.
